Description: At Sparky's, our highest priority is the health and well being of your beloved pet - everything we do is designed with you and your pet's safety in mind. To insure the best experience, our salon is bright, roomy and spotlessly clean, with a state-of the-art air purification system that eliminates airborne bacteria and flying pet hair. All grooming is done in plain view - if you like, your pet need never leave your sight. We created Sparky's to exercise our passion for great grooming. To earn the title of Trusted Expert, all Sparky's employees must undergo a rigorous written and hands-on training program. We've all mastered gentle, confident animal care and handling, as well as grooming skills that produce consistently beautiful results. In short, we make your pet look and feel great! Our specialty is the special-needs pet: animals with physical limitations such as advanced age or blindness are handled with the greatest of care and love. You'll see that we excel at providing a soothing, relaxing, therapeutic experience. As for people: we're great with you, too! You'll always be greeted with a sincere smile and treated with the respect and understanding you deserve. Our goal is to make your Sparky's experience as enjoyable as your pet's. Although we schedule dogs and cats by appointment, we also welcome walk-ins. From start to finish, a pet grooming at Sparky's lasts from one to three and a half hours depending on which services are being provided. In our experience, our customers can relax more, knowing they don't have to leave their pet with us all day. When your pet's ready, we'll call you so you can pick them up as soon as their grooming is completed. To guarantee the highest quality, we limit the number of pets we service in one day. We invite you to visit Sparky's, meet our friendly staff, look at our beautiful salon and see for yourself why we're the buzz of the grooming industry.

With a tradition of 35+ years of operating and owning pet retail and pet grooming businesses, our board holds the same values today it did in 1977 when the first pet grooming store was opened. If you can imagine a franchise company that considers its franchisees friends and family and firmly believes the franchise model allows a unique environment of mutual respect and autonomy with the safety net of a system, that is EarthWise Pet. In fact, our board members believe so strongly in relationships that there is a direct line of communication through our franchise intranet to allow stores to communicate directly with the owners!

Name: R.C. Dog Care
Description: R. C. Dog Care is designed to meet the socialization, exercise and development needs of your dog. Our 4,000 square foot cage-free facility allows dogs to continuously interact with the other dogs and our staff throughout the entire day. R. C. Dog Care will provide your dog the all-day enjoyment of supervised play with other dogs in spacious climate-controlled indoor playrooms, which will keep your pet comfortable in all weather. Dogs will play in separate supervised playgroups based on size and energy level. Smaller and less boisterous dogs will play in separate groups from the rough-and-rowdy dogs. Besides the exercise aspect of daycare, dogs are social animals. The companionship of people and other dogs at daycare makes these dogs calmer and easier to live with at home. You no longer have to leave your dog at home locked in the room or out in the backyard to prevent the destruction of your house due to separation anxiety. Your dog can now spend 1, 2, 3 or more days a week playing with other dogs and learning how to act appropriately around people and other dogs. Because playtime is supervised, calm, well-mannered behavior is constantly reinforced. We help house train young puppies, get them through teething without destruction, and give them critically important socialization with other puppies and nice dogs. Adolescents are probably our biggest group-after all, these are the terrible teens, the time when dogs need exercise and playtime most. But even mature and elderly dogs benefit from daycare. Description: Aristocats provides a home away from home atmosphere that cannot be found anywhere else in this area. Our hotel has large open rooms with furniture and bedding. This also provides the client peace of mind that their baby will be well cared for, safe, and loved. There are many reasons why people pamper their pets but probably the main one is that most pets are no longer looked on as just animals, but as family members. This is especially true for single people and older couples who often consider their pets as children as well as companions. As more pets are kept inside with more interaction with their human family members, grooming becomes more important, not only so they look and smell nice, but also to keep down shedding hair and parasites. Expectations for quality, cleanliness, expertise, and safety are becoming more and more important to consumers and this is easily shown in the pet industry ... just remember the widespread panic that occurred with the contamination of pet food! People are now looking closer at their pet food label than at their own food label. Allennia Voerster has been a Veterinary technician since 1981 and has a wide range of experience with cats, she also owns and shows pedigreed cats. Allennia has noticed a growing need for experienced cat grooming, especially for those cats that do not require sedation for grooming. Many Vet clinics will automatically sedate every cat that comes in, especially those that need shaving, and because Aristocats only caters to cats they are more relaxed and comfortable without the sight, sound, and smell of dogs - especially those that are not use to them. Aristocats provides the perfect grooming spa for your feline. Aristocats is open for boarding on all major holidays.

Name: Paw-A-Day Inn
Description: At Paw-A-Day Inn, we offer the ultimate pet boarding experience for your pet. We specialize in dog, cat, bird, lizard, small animal, and other exotic pet boarding. Our staff is passionate about animal care and is committed to ensuring your pet has a safe and exciting time with us. We are as dedicated to your pet's happiness and well being as if they were our own. Paw-A-Day Inn (previously known as Profgan Kennel Service) began in 2012 when we were looking for a place to leave our four fur babies, Oscar, Sumer, Tucker and Piper. Like all pet parents, we researched for the best place for our pets but were unable to locate a suitable match. We quickly realized there was an unmet need in Bowling Green; a need for a comfortable boarding experience with 24 hour care and no cages. We began providing pet care services (overnight stays, day care, baths and nail trims) in our home and gave other pet parents the peace of mind they had yet to find elsewhere. With an increase of referrals, we have grown and now expanded to a full scale 24 hour luxury pet resort in the heart of Bowling Green. We designed our resort with our own pets in mind. We are staffed 24 hours and are pleased to announce that each pet has their own bedroom suite rather than spending time in a cage. A night attendant is on duty after regular business hours to secure the building and grounds for the safety of each guest. Our night attendant makes rounds several times throughout the night to tend to any special guest needs, administer needed medications and to take care of any late-night pet suite housekeeping needs. We offer personalized services, one-on-one interaction, supervised outdoor play, supervised indoor play, photos of your pet online, social activities, grooming services and a full range of services that is everything you and your pet could hope to find!

Description: Doggy Daycare and Spa provides Grooming Services unlike any other. First of all, we groom one dog at a time. That means you won't find dogs sitting around waiting in kennels for their appointment. Secondly, we offer convenient appointment times six days a week! We also blow dry all dogs by hand and NEVER, EVER use cage dryers. Our Professional Groomers will tailor your dog's spa experience to meet your exact requirements. We only use the best products and offer a variety of shampoos and conditioning treatments. All of our Spa Appointments include an excellent bath with moisturizing conditioning treatment tailored to your dog's individual skin and coat condition. We blow dry all dogs by hand, trim their nails, clean out their ears, and trim out their feet, around their eyes, and sanitary area (if needed). If your dog will be getting a haircut, we encourage you to talk directly to your dog's Spa Specialist so you can communicate length and style. It is our goal to exceed your expectations and we never want to surprise a "parent" with their dog's new haircut! Many of our clients have remarked that taking their dog to be groomed was a stressful experience until coming to Doggy Daycare and Spa. You, too, will see the difference, not only in the exemplary grooming of your dog, but in how happy he or she is to return for his or her next Spa appointment! All of our Spa Pricing is determined by your dog's breed, coat type and condition, and temperament. For a price range, please call (517) 333-WOOF (9663). Doggy Daycare and Spa, Where Lansing's Hip Hounds Hang Out! Our Spa was completely remodeled in the spring of 2011.
